# Software and reproducibility

Record the exact repository commit, assay profile, haplotype catalogue, model
configuration, external database snapshots and commands used for every result.

```bash
python scripts/compile_assay.py --help
python scripts/admit_amplicon_reads.py --help
python scripts/build_hba_family_map.py --help
python scripts/genotype_amplicons.py --help
```

The Quarto source is the manuscript authority. HTML is used for iterative review;
Typst produces the PDF and preserves the generated `.typ` source for final layout
inspection.
